summary: This note describes where the TV series Lost was filmed, mainly on the Hawaiian island of Oahu, which was chosen for its accessible and varied locations. It covers the pilot's beach location, sound stages and studio moves, and urban areas around Honolulu that doubled for places worldwide. It also notes a few shoots elsewhere, including Los Angeles and London.
one_line: Overview of the filming locations used for the TV series Lost, mostly on Oahu, Hawaii, with Honolulu areas standing in for places worldwide.
key_facts: Lost was filmed on Panavision 35 mm cameras almost entirely on the Hawaiian island of Oahu.
Oahu was used because of its easily accessible, wide diversity of filming locations.
The original island scenes for the Lost pilot were filmed at Mokulē'ia Beach, near the northwest tip of Oahu.
Later beach scenes in Lost were filmed in secluded spots of the North Shore.
Cave scenes in Lost's first season were filmed on a sound stage built at a Xerox parts warehouse.
The Xerox parts warehouse had been empty since an employee mass shooting took place there in 1999.
In 2006, the Lost sound stage and production offices moved to the Hawaii Film Studio, operated by the Hawaii Film Office.
Sets for the Season 2 'Swan Station' and Season 3 'Hydra Station' interiors were built at the Hawaii Film Studio.

Various urban areas in and around Honolulu were used as stand-ins for locations including California, New York, Iowa, Miami, South Korea, Iraq, Nigeria, United Kingdom, Paris, Thailand, Berlin, Maldives, and Australia.
Scenes set in Sydney Airport were filmed at the Hawaii Convention Center.
A World War II-era bunker was used as both an Iraqi Republican Guard installation and a Dharma Initiative research station.
Winter scenes set in Germany were filmed at the Bernice P. Bishop Museum, with crushed ice scattered to create snow and Russian storeshop and automobile signs on the street.
Several scenes in the Season 3 finale 'Through the Looking Glass' were shot in Los Angeles, including a hospital set borrowed from Grey's Anatomy.
Two season four scenes were filmed in London because Alan Dale, who portrays Widmore, was performing in the musical Spamalot and was unable to travel to Hawaii.
Archives of Lost filming locations are tracked at a repository at the Lost Virtual Tour.
